construction.implementation_origin: Authored from scratch in this isolated build directory; no source files or other builds consulted.

commands.working_directory: Run both commands from this build directory.
commands.optional_injection: From Python: run_pipeline(input_envelope, embedder=local_callable). The CLI intentionally has no provider configuration or dynamic plugin import.

envelope.data: Unchanged, validated request object retained throughout every stage.
envelope.results: Exactly {} at input; then search; then search and sentiment; finally search, sentiment and review.

data.query: Nonblank text containing at least one word or number, at most 1000 characters.

options.min_relevance: Finite number in [0,1]; zero-scoring products are always excluded.

data.feedback: Array of {id, product_id, text, severity}; severity is low, medium, high or critical.
data.requirements: Array of {id, product_id, description, required_terms}; 1 to 50 distinct normalized phrases per requirement.

search_result.hits: Ranked array of {product_id, rank, score, lexical_score, embedding_score, matched_concepts, feedback_ids}.

sentiment_result.items: Priority-ordered array of {feedback_id, product_id, search_rank, relevance, sentiment_score, sentiment_label, cues, severity, priority_score, priority}.
sentiment_result.cue: {term, position, base_weight, multiplier, contribution}; position is the zero-based index in the word/punctuation token stream.

review_result.checks: Array of {requirement_id, product_id, status, evidence, missing_terms, feedback_ids, priority_score, priority}.
review_result.evidence: {term, document_id, start, end, quote}; offsets are zero-based Python character offsets into original document text, end-exclusive.
review_result.gaps: Gap-only projections preserving requirement_id, product_id, missing_terms, feedback_ids, priority_score and priority.
review_result.unreviewed_requirement_ids: Requirements belonging to products not selected by search; these are explicitly not assessed.
review_result.disclaimer: Always states the textual, non-certifying nature of the check.

validation: One shared validate_envelope layer is called before and after every public stage.
Exact fields, collection types, bounded values, unique record IDs, and product foreign keys are required.
IDs are 1 to 80 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, periods or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.
Each collection allows at most 1000 records; ordinary text fields allow at most 20000 characters; names and titles allow at most 200.
CLI input is UTF-8 with optional BOM, at most 2 MB; duplicate JSON keys and nonfinite constants are rejected.
Lexical-only search is independently recomputed at validation. Hybrid hits are checked for references, lexical scores, fusion, ordering, threshold and metadata.
Sentiment and review handoffs are compared with their deterministic recomputation, rejecting fabricated cues, priorities and evidence.
An error emits one JSON object {status: error, error: {type: validation_or_file_error, message: ...}} and exits 2. Success emits one envelope JSON object and exits 0.

cross_stage_handoffs.contract: Only feedback IDs carried by validated search hits are scored. Product ID, rank and relevance propagate to each insight; unrelated feedback is excluded.

Only requirements for selected products are reviewed. Validated per-product insight IDs and maximum issue priority propagate to every requirement check and gap. With no feedback, review still runs with score 0 and low priority.

semantic: Build an in-memory inverted index using Unicode word tokenization, case folding and an explicit small synonym map.
Use raw term frequencies weighted by 1 + log((1 + product_count)/(1 + document_frequency)); unseen query terms receive 1 + log(1 + product_count).
Compute cosine relevance, round to six decimals, filter by min_relevance, sort descending then by product ID, and apply top_k.
Optional injected embedder receives a single batch: query followed by product name plus description in product-ID order.
Validate one nonzero, finite, consistent-dimensional numeric vector per text; vectors have 1 to 4096 dimensions and coordinates within +/-1e100, excluding booleans.
Use numerically scaled vector normalization. Hybrid relevance is round(0.65 * lexical_cosine + 0.35 * max(0, embedding_cosine), 6). The caller is responsible for embedding quality and repeatability.
sentiment: Use the explicit positive/negative word lexicon in implementation.py and expose every matched contribution.
An odd number of not/no/never tokens in the previous three tokens reverses a cue. Punctuation and but/however reset the negation window.
Score is sum(contributions)/max(1,sum(abs(contributions))), rounded to six decimals. Labels use thresholds above 0.15 and below -0.15; otherwise neutral.
Priority score is severity baseline (low 10, medium 40, high 70, critical 100) plus round(max(0,-sentiment_score)*20), using Python rounding.
Severity dominates sentiment: positive critical feedback still outranks negative high feedback. No severity is inferred automatically.
Sort insights by descending priority, descending search relevance, then feedback ID.
review: Match required phrases as contiguous case-insensitive word-token sequences in document text, not titles. Punctuation and whitespace do not distinguish phrases.
Evidence must come from the same product; each term may be supported by a different document. Record the first occurrence per matching document with exact quote and source offsets.
Missing phrases produce traceable gaps; matches produce evidence_found, never certified or compliant.
Sort checks and gaps by descending propagated priority, then requirement ID. Report unselected requirement IDs separately.
Text that negates a requirement may still contain its required phrase: this is explicitly a mention checker, not factual entailment, legal interpretation or certification.

included: One integrated CLI pipeline with an immutable-style shared envelope and validated sequential stage handoffs.
Clearly labeled synthetic sample with three products, four feedback records, three requirements and three documents.
Deterministic semantic approximation, transparent sentiment and severity-aware ranking.
Fixture-tested optional local embedding interface, without live provider access.
Requirement phrase evidence, missing terms, source offsets and traceable prioritized gaps.
Offline unittest coverage, CLI error contracts and bounded input validation.
excluded: External dependencies, networks, model providers, agent delegation and git operations.
Enterprise production delivery, service hosting, databases, authentication and persistent search infrastructure.
Learned sentiment models, sarcasm interpretation, general semantic understanding and multilingual sentiment coverage.
LLM-generated reviews, document parsing/OCR, factual verification, legal advice or certification claims.
Cryptographic handoff authentication or proof that an injected embedding provider is honest; injection is a trusted local extension.
Automatic source-document remediation or live marketplace operations.

coverage: Synonyms, index statistics, tie-breaking, thresholding, top_k and empty/no-match searches.
Local embedding success, negative cosine, numeric stability, malformed vectors and callable failure.
Positive, negative, neutral and negated cues; severity dominance and explicit contribution arithmetic.
Search-to-feedback propagation, feedback-to-gap prioritization and severity-change propagation.
Product-scoped evidence, exact offsets, Unicode, word boundaries, missing documents and empty feedback.
Out-of-order stages, tampered search, sentiment and review handoffs, duplicate IDs and malformed input.
Actual subprocess CLI success, missing files, invalid file contents, directories and usage errors.
In-memory CLI fixtures for malformed JSON, duplicate keys, nonfinite values, invalid UTF-8, BOM and size limits.
